title: Button rounded corners
summary: Use background color and rounded corners to highlight the main actions on the page.
tasks: sets the top and bottom padding to 8px, the left and right padding to 16px, and the rounded corners to 999px.
hint: padding controls up and down, and the second value controls left and right. Swapping 8px and 16px makes the button taller and narrower.
goal: combines button color, padding, and rounded corners to highlight the main action of the page.

example.note: Set bright text and dark background for the print voucher button. The two padding values ​​control the top, bottom and left and right respectively.
